intro: The Zurina dressing table combines style and functionality, featuring a spacious storage area, a large mirror, and a built-in stool—perfect for organising essentials and enhancing your daily routine.

features.title: Refined, stylish finish
features.text: Showcasing a premium finish, the Zurina Dressing Table blends seamlessly with modern interiors, adding a sophisticated charm to any room.

features.title: Integrated stool for convenience
features.text: Comes with a matching built-in stool that enhances functionality while ensuring comfort, making your daily grooming sessions effortless and enjoyable.

features.title: Ample storage options
features.text: Features spacious drawers and shelves, allowing you to neatly organize cosmetics, accessories, and more, keeping your essentials within easy reach.

features.title: Large mirror for full visibility
features.text: Equipped with a full-sized mirror, it offers a clear and complete view, making it perfect for getting ready with confidence.

features.title: Compact design with high utility
features.text: Thoughtfully designed for small spaces, its compact form ensures maximum utility without compromising style or storage space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
